answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The delta of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The orchard holds work receipts rather than names, so the wharf of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
